    Build a co-word (co-occurrence) network

    Source: R/network-coword.R
    sm_network_coword.Rd

    Constructs an undirected co-word network. Nodes represent terms and an edge connects two terms if they co-occur within the same work. Edge weight equals the number of works in which both terms appear.

    Usage

    sm_network_coword(
  corpus,
  field = c("concepts", "title", "abstract", "keywords"),
  ngram = 1L,
  min_freq = 5L,
  stopwords = NULL,
  vocabulary = NULL,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

    Arguments

    corpus

    An sm_corpus object.

    field

    Character; the text field to extract terms from. One of "concepts" (default, uses corpus$concepts), "title", "abstract", or "keywords".

    ngram

    Integer; for free-text fields ("title", "abstract"), the n-gram size to tokenise into. Defaults to 1L (unigrams).

    min_freq

    Integer; minimum document frequency a term must have to be included. Defaults to 5L.

    stopwords

    Character vector of additional stopwords to remove when tokenising free text. Combined with tidytext::stop_words. Set to NULL (default) for no additional stopwords.

    vocabulary

    For field = "keywords" or "concepts", the concept vocabularies to take terms from: names of vocabularies or of families of sm_concept_vocabularies(), such as "author-keywords" or "indexer_keyword". NULL (default) means the author keywords for "keywords" (see Details) and every vocabulary for "concepts". Must be NULL for "title" and "abstract", whose terms come from the text.

    call

    Caller environment for error reporting.

    Value

    A tidygraph::tbl_graph object (undirected). Nodes carry name (the term) and freq (document frequency). Edges carry a weight column (co-occurrence count).

    Details

    When field = "concepts", terms come from the concept_name column in corpus$concepts (no tokenisation needed), of every vocabulary or of those named in vocabulary.

    When field = "keywords", terms are whole keywords from corpus$concepts, not tokenised. By default these are the author keywords (the author_keyword family: author-keywords, manual-tags); a corpus without any falls back to the indexer keywords (the indexer_keyword family: Keywords Plus, Scopus index keywords, Zotero automatic tags and MeSH) with a message, and a corpus with neither gives an empty network with a message. The fallback applies to the whole corpus, not per work.

    When field is "title" or "abstract", the text is tokenised with tidytext::unnest_tokens() using the chosen ngram size and stopwords are removed.

    Terms are lower-cased, and terms below min_freq are dropped. Empty input returns an empty undirected tbl_graph.

    See also

    Other networks: sm_network_citation(), sm_network_cocitation(), sm_network_collab(), sm_network_coupling(), sm_network_semantic()

    Examples

    corpus <- sm_example_corpus()
g <- sm_network_coword(corpus, field = "concepts", min_freq = 5L)
g
#> # A tbl_graph: 10 nodes and 45 edges
#> #
#> # An undirected simple graph with 1 component
#> #
#> # Node Data: 10 × 2 (active)
#>    name                     freq
#>    <chr>                   <int>
#>  1 biomarker discovery        74
#>  2 clinical outcomes          72
#>  3 colorectal cancer          82
#>  4 drug resistance            76
#>  5 gene expression            57
#>  6 immune checkpoint          79
#>  7 machine learning           66
#>  8 single-cell rna-seq        74
#>  9 spatial transcriptomics    67
#> 10 tumor microenvironment     58
#> #
#> # Edge Data: 45 × 3
#>    from    to weight
#>   <int> <int>  <int>
#> 1     1     2     21
#> 2     1     3     26
#> 3     1     4     30
#> # ℹ 42 more rows

# Keyword networks from a Web of Science file
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
writeLines(c(
  "PT J", "AU Doe, J", "TI First work",
  "DE heat illness; recruits; cooling", "ID HYPERTHERMIA; EXERCISE",
  "PY 2021", "UT WOS:000000000000001", "ER",
  "PT J", "AU Roe, R", "TI Second work",
  "DE heat illness; recruits", "ID HYPERTHERMIA; EXERCISE",
  "PY 2022", "UT WOS:000000000000002", "ER", "EF"
), path)
wos <- sm_read_wos(path, verbose = FALSE)
sm_network_coword(wos, field = "keywords", min_freq = 2L)
#> # A tbl_graph: 2 nodes and 1 edges
#> #
#> # An unrooted tree
#> #
#> # Node Data: 2 × 2 (active)
#>   name          freq
#>   <chr>        <int>
#> 1 heat illness     2
#> 2 recruits         2
#> #
#> # Edge Data: 1 × 3
#>    from    to weight
#>   <int> <int>  <int>
#> 1     1     2      2
sm_network_coword(wos, field = "keywords", vocabulary = "keywords-plus",
                  min_freq = 2L)
#> # A tbl_graph: 2 nodes and 1 edges
#> #
#> # An unrooted tree
#> #
#> # Node Data: 2 × 2 (active)
#>   name          freq
#>   <chr>        <int>
#> 1 exercise         2
#> 2 hyperthermia     2
#> #
#> # Edge Data: 1 × 3
#>    from    to weight
#>   <int> <int>  <int>
#> 1     1     2      2
